title: SDK quickstart & localized sample catalog for streaming + function-calling + structured output
creator: Priya Shah
description:
Goal: deliver a curated quickstart and localized sample catalog demonstrating streaming responses, function/tool calling, and structured output across the SDKs (Python, Node, Go). The kit should include: (1) three minimal quickstarts (streaming chat with function calls, structured JSON responses for form extraction, and streaming embeddings pipeline), (2) localized README translations for en, fr, de, ja, and (3) a sample verification CI that runs smoke tests and validates structured schema outputs. This ticket coordinates PM, Docs, SDK Eng, Design, and Localization to produce publish-ready artifacts and release notes entries.

Scope: author sample code, write short HOWTOs for each platform, create a release-notes matrix tying sample files to feature flags and API changes, design lightweight diagrams for console docs, onboard translations, and add telemetry checks to telemetry-dashboard for sample usage.

Out of scope: full tutorial videos, long-form blog posts (those are separate marketing tasks).
acceptance_criteria: Three minimal quickstarts implemented (python/node/go) covering: streaming + function-calling, structured-output JSON schema, and streaming embeddings ingestion
Localized README files included for en, fr, de, ja and validated by Localization team sign-off
Release notes entry drafted and reviewed with Marketing + Support, with a feature-to-filename matrix
Sample CI runs in sample-catalog repo and verifies: code lints, sample run passes against staging API, structured output matches schema
Design assets (two diagrams) uploaded and referenced by docs; UX copy approved by Design
tasks: Write Node quickstart: quickstart_streaming_function_call.js (Marcus) - include streaming chunk handling + function call handler
Write Python quickstart: quickstart_structured_output.py (Aisha) - validate JSON schema using pydantic
Write Go quickstart: quickstart_embeddings_stream.go (Evan) - example of streaming embedding ingestion
Create README templates and baseline English copy (Priya)
Open PRs in sdk-samples repository for each language (ENG review required)
Add smoke test workflow in .github/workflows/sample-ci.yml that posts to staging and asserts output schema
Prepare localized strings and send to L10n vendor (files: README.fr.md, README.de.md, README.ja.md)
Draft release notes matrix and link to changelog PR (see attachments)
Design: produce 2 SVGs (streaming flow and function-call flow) and annotate for console docs
Console: add sample entries to docs sidebar and confirm routing with Docs site owner
Coordinate support playbook snippet and add common troubleshooting steps (Auth errors, bad schemas, timeouts)
